candidates.old:
LDX #0
.classify
    STX ren_i
    STZ need,X
classify_xh = * + 1
    LDA rec_xh,X                    \ self-modified: rec_xh + boff
    INC A                           \ &FF: nothing drawn here (65C02 opcode)
    BNE shown_y
    LDA movers_x_high,X
    BMI classified                  \ nothing shown, nothing there
    \ RAM for cycles 4: not shown here, and its x cannot put it on the screen (its high byte past
    \ the right edge's, or more than one below the left edge's: widths are under 256), so it
    \ cannot go on (mark_to_draw's check_if_mover_is_on_screen) and nothing else lists it
    CMP viewport_right_high
    BEQ near_screen
    BCS classified                  \ right of the screen
.near_screen
    INC A                           \ 65C02 opcode
    CMP viewport_left_high
    BCC classified                  \ left of it
    BRA listed                      \ 65C02 opcode
.shown_y
    TXA                             \ Y = slot + boff for .shown (slot < 64: OR is the add)
    ORA boff
    TAY
candidates.new:
LDA viewport_right_high         \ the classify loop's limit: one past the right edge's high byte,
    INC A                           \ as the immediate below (65C02 opcode). High bytes of x are under
    STA classify_rh1                \ 128 but for the start-up view's &FF (wraps to 0: nothing is near,
                                    \ and that view's left edge, &FF, says the same)
    LDX #0
.classify
    STZ need,X
classify_xh = * + 1
    LDA rec_xh,X                    \ self-modified: rec_xh + boff
    INC A                           \ &FF: nothing drawn here (65C02 opcode)
    BNE shown_y
    LDA movers_x_high,X
classify_rh1 = * + 1
    CMP #0                          \ self-modified: viewport_right_high + 1. Carry set: right of the
    BCS classified                  \ screen, or nothing there (a high byte of 128 or more)
    \ RAM for cycles 4: not shown here, and its x cannot put it on the screen (its high byte past
    \ the right edge's, or more than one below the left edge's: widths are under 256), so it
    \ cannot go on (mark_to_draw's check_if_mover_is_on_screen) and nothing else lists it
.near_screen
    INC A                           \ 65C02 opcode
    CMP viewport_left_high
    BCS listed                      \ not left of it
    BRA classified                  \ 65C02 opcode: left of it
.shown_y
    STX ren_i                       \ read back after span_in_zone (the shown path only)
    TXA                             \ Y = slot + boff for .shown (slot < 64: OR is the add)
    ORA boff
    TAY
candidates.summary: Move STX ren_i out of the classify loop into .shown_y (only the shown path reads it: 2.55 of 34 slots a pass); a self-modified CMP #(right+1) replaces BMI + CMP + BEQ + BCS with CMP # + BCS (negative high bytes fall out of the same unsigned compare); the near path's BCC classified / BRA listed becomes BCS listed / BRA classified (always listed in the measured 4.75 of 4.75). Best candidate; 2-4 are subsets of it (alternatives).
candidates.equivalence: ren_i is read in this loop only at .shown's LDX ren_i (after span_in_zone). Every path to .shown passes through .shown_y (no other reference to .shown or .shown_y in src/), so storing X there gives .shown the same ren_i; the non-shown paths (listed via near_screen, classified) never read it, and X is intact there. mark_to_draw (STX ren_i at not_shown) and close_over_overlaps (STX ren_i in gather) set their own before any read, and no other file mentions ren_i; list_live/list_recorded/widen_by_live are reached only from those. DEBUG_FULLREDRAW's BRA stale after .shown keeps X. TXA/ORA/TAY follow the STX so A, Y are unchanged. After BMI-not-taken A = 0..127 and the old code takes classified iff A > right (BEQ near / BCS classified), near otherwise. New: classified iff A >= right+1 unsigned, i.e. A > right while right+1 does not wrap (right <= 127: every view in the world, whose columns number under 32768), and it also catches A >= 128 (the BMI case) since right+1 <= 128. When right = &FF (reset_screen_scroll's start-up view, whose left is &FF too), right+1 wraps to 0 and every A is classified; the old code reached near_screen for A in 0..127 but then A+1 <= 128 < left_high (&FF), so BCC classified: the same. Mover high bytes are 0..&4E or negative. A is 0..127 entering near_screen exactly as before (A < right+1 <= 128), so INC A / CMP viewport_left_high see the same A. The limit is read once before the loop: nothing in the loop (record_differs, span_in_zone) writes viewport_right_high (writes are only in game.6502's scroll and reset and render.6502's buffer_to_view/history_to_view, none called here), and the IRQ does not touch it. classify_rh1 is only reached from the loop, which is only entered after the setup. A is dead at the setup (in: nothing). BCC classified / BRA listed becomes BCS listed / BRA classified: C set goes to listed, C clear to classified, both as before. Neither target reads flags (listed: LDY act_n; classified: INX). Both targets are in branch range (listed about 50 bytes on, classified about 60).
candidates.relies_on: Moves code after the window by +2 bytes (6 setup bytes, STX removed and added, -4 from the branches/compare): every label after it in bank 4 slides by 2, so page crossings of later hot branches and tables can change (not counted here; the gate decides). Inside the window: BCS classified is forward; BCS listed is taken in the hot near path (a page-straddling branch/target would cost 1). classify_rh1 is a self-modified immediate in bank 4 sideways RAM, written where classify_xh already is (the code runs from RAM). Per pass: STX move 94 (101.9 less 7.6 at shown_y), limit 55 less the 9-cycle setup, swap 9.5.
